realReviews.author: Russ McGill
realReviews.text: Shane and Roofing Renovations were great to work with. We had storm damage and they went well above and beyond to work with us to get things resolved with the insurance company. Could not have asked for a more responsive, organized, knowledgable and supportive representative. The installation was great and even as a last step measure, they registered the roof warranty for us. 1000% would recommend them to anyone. Shane was likely the most supportive and attentive person we have ever worked with on a home repair.

realReviews.author: Ethel Williamson
realReviews.text: Shane Barber and his crew did a great job after storm damage blew the roof off our screened in porch and damaged the attached carport. Shane was a great help with the insurance company. The finished job is first class and the installation crew really cared about doing a quality job. It’s better than I imagined. I would use them again if I ever need any repairs or replacement.

realReviews.author: Erica Montgomery
realReviews.text:
Has been great working with Shaun, Ed, & the everyone I've spoken with along the way. The roof was done very quickly & the install team was awesome! We also had new siding & everything replaced. It was a great experience from start to finish!
Would definitely use RR again if needed!! 🤩

finalCta.headline: Got storm damage or an old roof?
finalCta.body: Send your address and a few photos or pick a time for an inspection. You'll get a written estimate before any work is booked.
finalCta.microcopy: No pressure. Just a straight answer about your roof.

faq.q: Can you help with my insurance claim?
faq.a: Yes. We inspect and document the damage and work with you and your insurance company to get the claim resolved.
Murfreesboro and the surrounding area, including Smyrna, La Vergne, Lascassas, Christiana, Woodbury and Shelbyville.

faq.q: Do you do gutters and siding too?
faq.a: Yes. Gutter replacement and siding are a big part of the work, often alongside a new roof.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to book an inspection.
